harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Implemented Ansible-based synchronization of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2, orchestrated from node3 (the only node with Ansible installed, hence the control node). Enabled sshd/generated host keys on node1 and node2, authorized node3's SSH key for root, created a source-of-truth app.conf on node1, and deployed an Ansible inventory + playbook on node3 that fetches from node1 and copies to node2. A cron job on node3 runs this every 5 minutes, well inside the 15-minute requirement. Verified propagation of multiple content changes automatically via the scheduled job. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service state, restarted each node one at a time with native reboot, confirmed boot_id changes, and confirmed recovery of services/data (ssh on node1/node2; cron+ansible tooling on node3). After node3's own restart, verified the sync pipeline still worked end-to-end by pushing a further change on node1 and confirming automatic cron-driven propagation to node2.
actions_performed: Identified node3 as the Ansible control node (only node with ansible-playbook installed)
Enabled sshd and generated missing SSH host keys on node1 and node2 (openssh-server was installed but inactive)
Authorized node3's root SSH key on node1 and node2 for passwordless Ansible connections
Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as the source-of-truth file
Built Ansible inventory (hosts.ini) and playbook (sync-playbook.yml) on node3: fetches app.conf from node1, copies to node2
Ran the playbook manually and verified matching md5 checksums on node1/node2
Installed a cron job (*/5 * * * *) on node3 running run-sync.sh, logging to /var/log/inventory-sync.log
Changed app.conf on node1 twice and confirmed automatic cron-triggered sync propagated each change to node2 with matching checksums
Captured baseline boot_id and service health on node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially via native reboot, one at a time
Verified boot_id changed on each node after restart
Verified ssh service and app.conf integrity recovered on node1/node2; verified cron, ansible playbook files, and crontab survived reboot on node3
Made a final config change on node1 post-restarts and confirmed the cron-driven Ansible sync still automatically replicated it to node2

evidence.requirement: node1 app.conf established as source of truth
evidence.summary: Confirmed no app.conf existed initially on node1; created it with initial content and captured its checksum.

evidence.requirement: Ansible control node identification and setup
evidence.summary: Only node3 had ansible/ansible-playbook installed; inspected its ansible.cfg, ssh key, and helper scripts to confirm it as control node.

evidence.requirement: SSH connectivity enabled from control node to managed nodes
evidence.summary: Diagnosed inactive sshd due to missing host keys, generated keys, enabled ssh on node1/node2, authorized node3's key, and confirmed passwordless root SSH works from node3.

evidence.requirement: Ansible playbook performs the sync correctly
evidence.summary: Created inventory and playbook; ran manually and confirmed node2's app.conf matches node1's checksum after run.

evidence.requirement: Sync picks up changes automatically within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: Installed 5-minute cron job on node3; changed app.conf on node1 and observed the scheduled (not manually triggered) cron tick automatically replicate the change to node2 with matching checksums within ~2 minutes.

evidence.requirement: Baseline health capture before restarts
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, uptime, service status, and app.conf checksum baseline on all three nodes prior to any restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Issued reboot (ack returned before disconnect), confirmed unreachable mid-reboot, confirmed new boot_id (3a83264a... vs baseline 1e0cb179...), and verified ssh active and app.conf intact after restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Issued reboot, confirmed connection reset mid-reboot, confirmed new boot_id (14de4c7d... vs baseline 901ef286...), and verified ssh active and app.conf intact after restart.

evidence.requirement: node3 (control node) restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Issued reboot, confirmed unreachable mid-reboot, confirmed new boot_id (65e902c2... vs baseline 6fd57414...), and verified cron active with crontab and ansible-sync files intact after restart.

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism survives control-node restart
evidence.summary: After node3's restart, changed app.conf on node1 (max_connections=123) and confirmed the still-scheduled cron job automatically synced the new content to node2, matching checksum 2a0f5842...
